limitations.limit: All 88 processor fixtures start FP32 C at +0. Twelve two-FEDP cases synthesize nonzero intermediate C. Arbitrary externally supplied C remains leaf-only; the application contract explicitly excludes nonzero initial matrix C.

K is 8 or 16: two or four sequential four-product FEDPs, maximum two K8 tiles. The application supports other positive complete multiples, but this evidence does not qualify K>16 or unrestricted long-chain behavior.

Four K16 numerical cases distinguish reversal of complete K8 tiles; they explicitly do not distinguish independently rounded tile sums. No broader cross-tile rounding proof is claimed. This is a disclosed test-sensitivity limit, not a new gate or an automatic failure of the enumerated A02 criterion.

Four finite max-FP16 products cannot overflow FP32, and the lifted FP16 tiny products remain finite. BF16 cases supply signed overflow and signed output-FTZ coverage; FP16 claims remain range-applicable.
Only FP16/BF16 to FP32 arithmetic is qualified. Enabled TF32/FP8/MX/integer API positives, tensor_mx catalog runtime checks and historical P01 TF32 evidence have separate scopes.
The supported rejection boundary is C++ template instantiation plus strict host fixture input checks. No runtime hardware trap, raw instruction behavior or fmt_d rejection is promised.
Compact row-major A / column-major B / row-major output only; shapes 8x4x8, 8x4x16 and 16x8x16. No arbitrary strides, padding, tails, operand transposition or matrix-load feature qualification.
No WGMMA A03 pass; no full AFU, vendor hw_emu, physical FPGA or silicon qualification.

Native TFR tensor and STD scalar floating-point datapaths, with inherited integer multiply/divide DPI helpers. SV_DPI remains in RTL configuration; active RV64 helpers include dpi_lmul and dpi_ldiv. No universal DPI-free processor claim.

Independent legacy review records an inherited int mismatch-counter overflow possibility for extremely large random matrices. This is outside the bounded fixture corpus and was neither introduced nor worsened by the reporting restoration; it is not silently claimed fixed.

The three completed local RV64 catalog representatives pass their unchanged tolerance checks. These are compatibility supplements, not exact P02-A02 fixture evidence. The source publication and hosted CI observations are separate delivery records; no full20-pair result is inferred from the local subset.
No full-shell/vendor hw_emu, physical FPGA, silicon, synthesis/timing, throughput, power, WGMMA concurrency or model-cycle-parity qualification.
